regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Article identity and aggregate terminal-allenol claim were inspected; the abstract is not decomposed into experiment records independently of the later tables and schemes.
Generic CuI/Cy2NH/paraformaldehyde terminal-allenol synthesis with R groups, n values, and 60-88% range; classified as one general scheme rather than a unique experiment.

Crabbe CuBr/diisopropylamine chemistry, earlier CuI modification, ZnI2 protocol, and allenol applications are cited prior work. They lack uniquely specified experiment rows on this page and were not misclassified as current experiments.
Narrative isolated-yield statements map to Table 1 Conditions B rows on page 2 and were merged as cross-page evidence rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Scheme 1's precursor arrow is generic and unlabeled; unique substrate structures, scale, time, workup, and yield basis are unavailable.
No SI file was supplied or explicitly associated.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1 reaction arrows, rows 1-10, and footnote a
regions.finding: Twenty independent experiments were retained: Conditions A and B for each of ten propargylic-alcohol rows, with shared 2.0 mmol/3.0 mL conditions, row times, and row yields.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 2 reaction arrows, rows 1-3, and footnote a
regions.finding: Six independent homopropargylic-alcohol experiments were retained: separate Conditions A and B results for each row, with shared scale/solvent, row times, and yields.
Three generic cited routes were classified as literature examples: LiNH2/R2X alkylation (ref. 14), EtMgBr/RCHO addition (ref. 15), and base/ethylenediamine triple-bond migration (ref. 16).

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Scheme 2 Conditions A/B product lines and footnote a
regions.finding: Seven distinct current experiments were retained: A/B for 2n, A/B for 2p, A and 2 mmol B for 2o, plus the separate footnoted 29.6 mmol Conditions B run giving 72%. The three page-3 procedures were merged into the matching 2o records.

The Table 2, Scheme 2, and optically active Scheme 3 results are summarized; the procedure is explicitly limited to terminal allenols. Summary prose was linked to row/arrow records rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Conditions A table yields do not state a measurement basis; most rows omit atmosphere, workup, purification, and isolated masses.
Generic precursor routes lack unique structures and operating details.
No SI file was supplied or associated.

regions.region: page 3 upper Scheme 3 full arrow sequence
regions.finding: Seven arrows were retained separately: propargylic-alcohol preparation, ref.-17 Novozym resolution, acetate hydrolysis, two triple-bond migrations to (S)-1p/(R)-1p, and two CuI-mediated conversions to (S)-2p/(R)-2p with yields and ee values.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left typical procedure for Conditions A
regions.finding: Detailed 2 mmol preparation of 2o under CuBr/i-Pr2NH conditions gives 134.2 mg (37%) after 2.4 h; merged with Scheme 2 2o Conditions A.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left/right typical procedure for Conditions B
regions.finding: Detailed 2 mmol preparation of 2o under CuI/Cy2NH conditions gives 243.2 mg (66%) after 2.4 h; merged with Scheme 2 2o Conditions B.
Separate 29.6 mmol CuI/Cy2NH run gives 3.8875 g 2o (72%) after 3 h; retained independently from the 2 mmol/66% experiment.

regions.region: page 3 general information, characterization, and acknowledgement
regions.finding: Instrument/material information and 2o spectra are characterization context, not new reactions. The generic reproduction acknowledgement lacks a run mapping and was not turned into a duplicate experiment.

unresolved: Most Scheme 3 arrows omit scale, time, workup, purification, isolated mass, and yield basis; exact stereochemical structures remain source-label candidates.
The acknowledgement does not identify which results Minyan Wang reproduced.
The paper points to SI, but no SI file is associated.

regions.finding: The page states that Supporting Information is available online, but source_mapping marks association unestablished and no SI file is supplied; no SI facts were inferred.

Bibliographic citations and review references only. External papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments; cited routes already explicitly depicted in Schemes 2-3 remain classified as literature context where appropriate.

unresolved: External cited papers and their unprinted operating details are outside the supplied experiment evidence.
